evidence.evidence_text: Utilizing large language models (LLMs) for data augmentation has yielded encouraging results in mathematical reasoning.
To this end, we propose ControlMath, an iterative method involving an equation-generator module and two LLM-based agents.
The module creates diverse equations, which the Problem-Crafter agent then transforms into math word problems.
